description:
The Federal Bureau of Prisons (BOP), Bastrop, Texas intends to make an award of an indefinite delivery/requirements type contract/Blanket Purchase Agreement with firm fixed prices to a responsible entity for the provision of Mobile x-ray services. The Mobile X-ray company will provide services for the inmates incarcerated at the Federal Correctional Institution (FCI), located in Bastrop, Texas

This is a Sources Sought only, for gathering informaiton.
